text:
incident-bot: Pager — P1: unusual auth traffic + potential log push to external S3 bucket detected for edge-proxy service. Auto-created incident-1799991111. Please acknowledge.
elaine: ack — oncall. seeing a burst of 401/403 from a handful of service clients.
raj: looking — got an alert from the egress monitor, outbound S3 PutObject spikes from staging and one prod node.
security-oncall: pinging sec infra
oncall-sre: tagging network team, isolating node pool now. telling k8s to cordon the 3 nodes with highest egress.
maria: can you paste the log sample?
raj: pasted samples: ```
edge-proxy ERROR request_id=abc123 user=svc-ingest tenant=redwood-prod path=/v1/upload status=200 external_dst=s3://suspicious-bucket/2026-03-18/log.tar.gz
edge-proxy INFO kvcache miss user=svc-ingest
```
elaine: 200 response for objects — that looks like legitimate upload but destination is unknown. check service-account used for uploads.
security-oncall: running quick IAM query: PutObject calls used key svc-ingest-sa. That SA should only target internal buckets. policy shows new inline policy grant to arn:aws:s3:::*/* (suspicious).
oncall-sre: rolling back that IAM change now. running: `aws iam delete-user-policy --user-name svc-ingest-sa --policy-name temp-elevate`
raj: confirmed policy removed, creating temporary deny SCP at edge egress to S3 for that principal.
maria: is customer data at risk? which buckets were targeted?
raj: target list: suspicious-bucket (external), redwood-logs-prod (internal). Copies of logs to external bucket are possible for last 12 minutes window.
eng-lead: stand up quick forensic snapshot: snapshot the node volumes and preserve the k8s pod logs (kubectl cp). We need to preserve evidence.
elaine: action list: 1) isolate node pool (oncall-sre) 2) revoke svc-ingest-sa keys and issue new ephemeral creds (security-oncall) 3) block outbound S3 to unknown buckets at edge (raj) 4) snapshot artifacts (maria/eng-lead) 5) notify legal if any customer PII (elaine)
security-oncall: rotating keys now: `aws iam update-access-key --access-key-id AKIA... --status Inactive` then create new key pair and enqueue to secrets manager. Also generating audit log of API calls via CloudTrail.
oncall-sre: isolation done — cordoned nodes: node-12 node-13 node-14, drained pods with `kubectl drain`. ingress traffic diverted by routing fallback.
raj: egress block applied via WAF lambda rule to block s3 endpoints outside redwood-*. Confirming 0 PutObject attempts after rule applied.
maria: snapshot complete and logs archived to forensics bucket (w/ restricted access). list: `/forensics/1799991111/edge-logs.tar.gz`
incident-bot: status update created: investigators assigned: elaine (incident commander), raj (network), maria (runtime forensics), security-oncall (IAM/keys), oncall-sre (isolation).
elaine: quick customer impact check — routing fallback introduced higher latency for some requests. Telemetry shows 3% error increase for short window. No outage reported. Notify accounts if any customer S3 objects were leaked.
security-oncall: preliminary audit: external-bucket owner appears unrelated. We have evidence of 4 PutObject calls with copies of truncated logs (no full customer payloads found yet) — need deeper scan.
legal: please DM me the list of tenants touched and any potential PII evidence. We need to consider notifications.
elaine: assigning postmortem owner and comms: eng-lead will draft internal timeline, legal will advise on external notice.
eng-lead: will start timeline doc and coordinate with customer success for messaging.
raj: checklist for mitigation completed, leaving a temporary deny on svc-ingest-sa until rotation finished.
security-oncall: new keys issued and rotated into Secrets Manager; old keys disabled. Running a quota of token revocation across long-lived sessions.
maria: running content scan across archived logs — results in ~10 minutes.
elaine: customer-impact assessment: small latency spike + potential exfil of truncated logs to one external bucket. classification: medium-sev security incident, no confirmed PII leak yet.
incident-bot: update incident status -> mitigation in progress, severity -> P1 (security).
raj: can someone verify there are no other principals with similar inline policy? running IAM inventory.
security-oncall: doing an account-wide IAM diff. will post findings.
maria: scan complete: 2 log files contained masked request IDs, no plaintext customer payloads identified. marking as low probability of PII.
legal: based on current evidence, draft notification not required yet but still under review. please tag me if we discover customer IDs.
elaine: I'll do a brief bridge summary for execs in 20m. please drop any ETA or blockers in this thread.
oncall-sre: leaving remediation tasks as runbook checklist in the incident doc. Handing on-call to raj for the next 30m — raj you good to take?
raj: taking over on-call in bridge. I have network egress monitoring and IAM scans running.
eng-lead: post-incident actions: add egress allow-lists, alert for anomalous inline policy changes, require KMS-backed bucket whitelisting for uploads, and tighten SA permissions.
incident-bot: incident-1799991111 will remain open until evidence review and keys rotation audit complete.
elaine: thanks everyone. quick note: update when legal confirms notification decision or if forensics finds PII. :thumbsup:
security-oncall: will follow up with final IAM diff and CloudTrail export link.
raj: update: no other principals found with suspicious policies. closing immediate containment tasks.
maria: uploaded final scan: `/forensics/1799991111/scan-results.json`
legal: reviewing artifacts now. expect update within 2 hours.
elaine: last check — are there any customer-facing incidents to open? customer-success?
eng-lead: CS wait for legal. we'll prep a hold message template but not send.
elaine: ok we’ll move to monitoring mode. keep this thread updated with any new findings.
incident-bot: incident-1799991111 last activity recorded at 1799991400.
summary: P1: inbound auth traffic + suspicious S3 uploads from svc-ingest-sa. nodes isolated, IAM policy rollback, key rotation, egress block applied, forensics running, legal reviewing customer impact.
